title: 🚀 Smooth Expanding Navigation Menu with Animation | HTML, CSS & JS
description:
Hey devs! 👋 I just built a beautiful expanding navigation menu using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! 🏗️✨ This menu starts as a compact button and smoothly expands to reveal links with a cool rotating effect. 🔄

🔹 Smooth width transition for expansion
🔹 Rotating link effect when opening
🔹 Minimal and modern design
🔹 Pure CSS animation with JavaScript toggle
